_about: The rooms server the app talks to (rooms-worker/, on Cloudflare). npm run build:site reads it; ROOMS_URL=... overrides it.
_appUrl: The app's main address (the owner's choice, 24 Sep 2026): docs/ served by Cloudflare (site-worker/, npm run deploy:site). Every link the app shares - the app, a room, its QR - points here, from either copy. npm run check:live checks it serves this build.
_githubUrl: The same build on GitHub Pages (the push publishes it): the first address, kept so old icons, links and QR codes keep working. npm run check:live checks it too.
_icon: Which colourway tools/make-icons.mjs draws the mark in: deep, violet, midnight, paper, ocean or sunset.
_iconVersion: Bump when the icon changes. It versions the icon addresses (Android then updates by itself) and tells an iPhone copy on the home screen that it carries an older icon.
